task_definition.task_description: Please check my calendar availability starting on 2024-10-24, then look up information for Hilton Tokyo. After that, get the current weather alert for Tokyo, Japan, archive that weather alert for my trip, then set a high-priority reminder for 2024-10-23 18:00 to check the archived weather, and finally create and email me a trip preparation summary based on that archived weather info.
